title: Tiered Pager Attenuation and Autonomic Incident Triage Pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Reduce noisy pages during transient SLO deviations while preserving fast wake-up for true incidents. Deliver a tiered attenuation layer that applies SLO-aware throttles, region-aware circuit-breaker heuristics, and an autonomic triage pipeline that enriches, suppresses, or escalates alerts automatically. Background: Over the last 6 months the oncall team reports ~37% of pages are duplicates or low-actionability (alerts from warm KV-cache misses, short-duration latency spikes during rolling deploys). Existing suppression is static (30m windows) and causes either missed incidents or excessive noise. Scope: 1) Define SLO tiers (gold/silver/bronze) mapped to alert sensitivity and escalation policies. 2) Implement a lightweight proxy filter (alert-attenuator) that:   - applies short probabilistic suppression for transient bursts (decaying suppression over 2–10s),   - dedups alerts with temporal and fingerprint similarity,   - suppresses alerts during known canary windows and controlled deploys based on signals from deployment service. 3) Circuit breaker tuning: per-region thresholds that trigger graceful load-shedding, with an automatic fallback to adjacent region; expose circuit state to alerting layer. 4) Autonomic triage pipeline: anomaly score computed from multi-signal inputs (SLO burn rate, error-class fingerprints, region traffic delta, KV miss rate) that assigns severity and populates PagerDuty pages with runbook steps and relevant links. 5) Runbook enrichment and automated actions: include one-click remediation links (route to rolling-restart job, toggle synthetic checks, scale dedicated pool) and optional automated mitigations for P0 conditions (e.g., regional traffic shift + shedding). Acceptance criteria: 1) Pager volume from non-actionable alerts decreases by >=45% on canary traffic tests. 2) True positive P0 incidents still notify within target latency (<=30s from anomaly detection). 3) False suppression rate <2% measured across 30-day replay against historical incidents. 4) Circuit breaker transitions are visible in Console and cause controlled load-shedding flows with automatic fallback in >=95% of simulated region failovers. 5) Runbook enrichment appears in 100% of automated pages for incidents with severity >=P1. Implementation notes: - Alert fingerprints: combine error class, endpoint, model-id, region, and KV-cache key prefix. - Use a ring-buffer short-term dedupe store with 15s TTL for burst dedupe. - Probabilistic suppression: initial suppression probability function scales with event frequency and per-SLO burn rate. - Autonomic triage will run in a separate service (incident-clarity) that subscribes to alert stream and writes decisions to a metadata topic consumed by PD/Slack webhooks. - Integrations: PagerDuty, Slack, Console incident sidebar, Deployments service hooks. Rollout plan: 1) Implement unit tests and local simulator using 4 weeks of production traces to validate suppression heuristics. 2) Canary in eu-west-1 with 10% traffic for 1 week; compare pages/day and MTTR. 3) If canary pass, expand to us-west-2 and us-east-1 in staged increments. 4) Post-rollout, enable automatic mitigations only in passive mode for 1 week (actions logged but not executed), then enable active mitigation after SRE review. Metrics & dashboards: - Pages/day (total / actionable / suppressed) - Suppression false-positive rate (replayed incidents) - Time-to-notify for P0/P1 - Circuit breaker open/close rate and regional failover success rate - Cost impact of load-shedding (estimated dropped tokens) Links & artifacts: - Design doc: https://confluence.redwood/example/tiered-pager-attenuation - Simulator & replay harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alert-sim - Initial proto PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1843 - Console dashboard draft: https://console.redwood/intraday/dashboards/alert-attenuation
acceptance_criteria: Pager volume from non-actionable alerts decreases by >=45% during canary
Circuit breaker transitions visible in Console and >=95% controlled fallback success
Runbook enrichment included in all automated pages for severity >=P1
tasks: Design alert fingerprint schema and dedupe store
Implement alert-attenuator service and probabilistic suppression module
Build incident-clarity triage service and PD/Slack enrichment hooks
Expose circuit breaker state to Console and alerting layer
Create simulator/replay harness and run canary experiments
Author runbook templates and automated remediation playbooks
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Over-suppression misses true incidents -> Mitigation: conservative suppression thresholds and passive-mode logging for 1 week
Risk: New service increases latency in alert path -> Mitigation: async enrichment and keep fast-pass for high-severity signals
Risk: Incorrect triage severity -> Mitigation: human-in-the-loop approvals and rollback toggles
rollout_plan: Local simulation against 4 weeks of traces
Canary in eu-west-1 at 10% traffic for 7 days
Enable passive-mode automated mitigations for 7 days
Enable active mitigations after SRE signoff and postmortem review
monitoring: Circuit-breaker state changes and regional failover success
